title: Graded image-filtration comparison and bottom spectral-object factorization
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category, $Y$ an $\operatorname{EInt}$-indexed first-quadrant abelian spectral object, and $E$ its standard $E_2$ spectral sequence on nonnegative bidegrees [def-sp-spectral-sequence]. Let $H:\mathbb N\to C$ and $h_n:Y.H^n(\bot,\top)\simeq H_n$ be specified isomorphisms. Let $T_n$ be decreasing filtrations [def-sp-filtration] with $T_n^i$ exactly the image, transported by $h_n$, of $Y.H^n(\bot,n+1-i)\to Y.H^n(\bot,\top)$. Let $t_{p,r}:E_r^{p,0}\to E_{r+1}^{p,0}$ for $r\ge2$ satisfy $i_{\rm cycles}t_{p,r}=\pi_{\rm homology}\,\mathrm{iso}_r$. Let $b_{p,r}:E_2^{p,0}\to E_r^{p,0}$ satisfy $b_{p,2}=1$ and $b_{p,r+1}=b_{p,r}t_{p,r}$. There are isomorphisms $g_{p,q}:\operatorname{gr}^pT_{p+q}\simeq E_\infty^{p,q}$, where $E_\infty^{p,q}=E_{p+q+2}^{p,q}$, and $k_p:E_\infty^{p,0}\simeq T_p^p$, such that the quotient projection $T_p^p\to\operatorname{gr}^pT_p$ followed by $g_{p,0}$ is $k_p^{-1}$. The canonical page-two interval comparison $E_2^{p,0}\to Y.H^p(0,1)$, followed by the spectral-object bottom edge and $h_p$, equals $b_{p,p+2}$ followed by $k_p$ and the inclusion $T_p^p\to H_p$. This theorem only compares graded pieces and the bottom projection of the specified image filtration; it does not construct $Y$, $t$, $b$, or cohomology comparisons.

proof.text: The abutment of a first-quadrant spectral object identifies consecutive image-filtration quotients with stable spectral-object terms. Transport these cokernel isomorphisms by h. The standard spectral-object page comparison identifies them with the terms at page p+q+2, supplying g.

First-quadrant vanishing makes T_p^(p+1) zero. Its arrow into T_p^p is zero, so the cokernel projection is an isomorphism. Compose g_(p,0)^(-1) with the inverse projection to obtain k; the quotient equation follows by cancellation.

On the bottom row cycles inclusion is invertible, hence ht uniquely determines every t and hb2,hbt uniquely determine b by integer induction. Express successor-page homology isomorphisms using the spectral-object kernel/image model: the transition is the quotient map of its opcycles. Induct through r=2,...,p+1; their composite is the opcycles quotient from interval (0,1) to the stabilized bottom term. Its composite with the inclusion of the image filtration is the defining inverse of H^p(bottom,1)->H^p(0,1), followed by H^p(bottom,1)->H^p(bottom,top), namely bottomEdge. Transport through h to obtain the displayed factorization.
